root.label: Explosions reported at Ethiopian military headquarters

events.label: Explosions reported at Ethiopian military headquarters

slots.name: blast count
slots.sentence: The Associated Press, citing security sources, reported that there had been three blasts that came after the government banned the use of drones in the capital.

slots.name: time of explosion
slots.sentence: The AFP news agency reported that the explosion took place at the Ethiopian National Defense Force (ENDF) headquarters between midnight and 1:00am local time, citing diplomatic and security sources with the information.

slots.name: probable cause
slots.sentence: AFP quoted a diplomatic source as saying small drones were the most probable cause of the blast.
